features.name: Spellcasting
features.summary: Charisma-based casting from the sorcerer list; cantrips, spells known, and slots per the Sorcerer table. Swap one known spell on level-up. Arcane focus usable.

features.name: Sorcerous Origin
features.summary: Choose Draconic Bloodline or Wild Magic; it grants features at 1st, 6th, 14th, and 18th level.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.summary: Gain sorcery points (table column, regained on a long rest). Flexible Casting: bonus action to turn points into a slot of up to 5th level, or a slot into points equal to its level.

features.name: Metamagic
features.summary: Learn two Metamagic options, plus one more at 10th and 17th level. Normally only one option can be applied per spell.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (maximum 20).

features.name: Sorcerous Restoration
features.summary: Regain 4 spent sorcery points whenever you finish a short rest.

choices.name: Careful Spell
choices.summary: 1 point: when a spell forces saves, up to Cha modifier (min 1) chosen creatures automatically succeed.

choices.name: Distant Spell
choices.summary: 1 point: double a range of 5 ft. or more, or make a touch spell's range 30 ft.

choices.name: Empowered Spell
choices.summary: 1 point: reroll up to Cha modifier (min 1) damage dice and keep the new results; can be combined with another Metamagic option.

choices.name: Extended Spell
choices.summary: 1 point: double a duration of 1 minute or longer, capped at 24 hours.

choices.name: Heightened Spell
choices.summary: 3 points: one target has disadvantage on its first save against the spell.

choices.name: Quickened Spell
choices.summary: 2 points: a spell with a 1-action casting time is cast as a bonus action instead.

choices.name: Subtle Spell
choices.summary: 1 point: cast without verbal or somatic components.

choices.name: Twinned Spell
choices.summary: Points equal to spell level (1 for a cantrip): a single-target, non-self spell also targets a second creature in range.

choices.name: Convert slot to points
choices.summary: Bonus action: expend a spell slot to gain sorcery points equal to its level.

features.name: Dragon Ancestor
features.summary: Choose a dragon type (sets your ancestry damage type). You know Draconic, and double your proficiency bonus on Charisma checks with dragons when it applies.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.summary: +1 hit point maximum per sorcerer level; unarmored AC is 13 + Dex modifier.

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.summary: Add Cha modifier to damage from spells of your ancestry type; spend 1 sorcery point to resist that type for 1 hour.

features.name: Dragon Wings
features.summary: Bonus action to grow or dismiss wings giving a fly speed equal to your speed; not while wearing armor not made for them.

features.name: Draconic Presence
features.summary: Action, 5 sorcery points: 60-ft. aura (concentration, up to 1 minute); hostiles starting their turn in it make a Wis save or are charmed (awe) or frightened (fear); success grants 24-hour immunity.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.summary: After you cast a 1st-level or higher sorcerer spell, the DM may have you roll a d20; on a 1, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.summary: Gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Recharges on a long rest, or early if the DM triggers a surge roll after you cast a 1st-level+ sorcerer spell.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.summary: Reaction, 2 sorcery points: when a creature you see makes an attack, check, or save, add or subtract 1d4 from its roll (after the roll, before effects).

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.summary: When rolling on the Wild Magic Surge table, roll twice and pick either result.

features.name: Spell Bombardment
features.summary: Once per turn, when a spell damage die rolls its maximum, roll one such die again and add it to the damage.

choices.name: Wild Magic Surge table (d100)
choices.summary: 50 random effects in paired d100 bands (01-02 ... 99-00): self-centered spells (fireball, confusion, fog cloud, polymorph, etc.), teleports, cosmetic changes, short buffs or curses, summoned creatures, and at 99-00 regaining all sorcery points.

discrepancies: Wild Magic subclass exists in the app (id 'wild-magic', srd false) with an empty features list; PHB gives Wild Magic Surge (1), Tides of Chaos (1, 1/long rest), Bend Luck (6), Controlled Chaos (14), Spell Bombardment (18), plus the d100 surge table.

Metamagic: the app only has 'Metamagic: Twinned Spell' as a feature; the other seven PHB options (Careful, Distant, Empowered, Extended, Heightened, Quickened, Subtle) are missing, and there is no option-list structure to choose from.
progression special.metamagic_known is 4 at level 16; PHB gives the 4th option only at 17th, so level 16 should be 3.

Feature naming differs from the book: app uses 'Spellcasting: Sorcerer' (book: 'Spellcasting') and splits Font of Magic's sub-rules into separate features 'Flexible Casting: Creating Spell Slots' and 'Flexible Casting: Converting Spell Slot' listed in the level-2 progression row; the book table lists only 'Font of Magic'.

Draconic subclass is named 'Draconic' in the app; the book name is 'Draconic Bloodline'. The ten dragon ancestries are stored as ten extra subclass features ('Dragon Ancestor: Black - Acid Damage', ...) each with a copy of the Dragon Ancestor text, instead of an option list; all ten dragon/damage-type pairs themselves are correct.
Twinned Spell desc includes an extra eligibility paragraph (magic missile / scorching ray example) that comes from later errata/SRD, not the 2014 PHB printing.

Sorcery Points have no resource/uses entry (max = Sorcery Points column, long rest); Tides of Chaos (1/long rest) also untracked. Sorcery point values in progression.special (0 at 1, then equal to level) match the book.

Progression rows for 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15 have empty features, matching the book's dashes. No mismatch found for hit die (d6), saves (Con, Cha), weapons (daggers, darts, slings, quarterstaffs, light crossbows; no armor/tools), skills (2 from Arcana, Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Persuasion, Religion), cantrips, spells known, spell slots, or creating-spell-slot costs (2/3/5/6/7).
